author: carwow
description:
Lamborghini Revuelto: It’s powered by a 6.5-litre NA V12, coupled with three electric motors. These combine to produce 1,015hp and 1,062Nm, with this power sent to all four wheels. It weighs in at 1,872kg, and it’s incredibly expensive, costing £558,000!

BMW M140i: It’s powered by a 3.4-litre 6-cylinder turbo, and in low boost mode this creates 1,200hp and 1,500Nm! This is sent to all four wheels via an 8-speed auto, and it’s by far the lightest here, weighing just 1,475kg! The car and the mods combined cost £110,000.
title: World’s FASTEST BMW M140i v Lambo Revuelto: DIAL CAM DRAG RACE

The all-new Audi Q9 and SQ9 have been revealed. We’ll walk around the exterior design, interior design, discuss the engine options and reveal the price.

This is the all-new Audi Q9 and SQ9! 

It’s the largest production car Audi has ever produced, both in terms of length, height, and width! It’s an absolutely colossal 7-seater! 

The question is, does it do enough to appeal to those of you looking for a 7-seater when there are class-leaders like the Mercedes GLS and BMW X7 out there? Let’s take a closer look. 

In terms of the exterior design, Audi has made an effort to make the Q7 look like a truly premium product. Around the back, the panels are all smooth, with an embedded Audi logo across the middle, while there are also curved LED taillights on either side.
